Q1.purpose: Identify product IDs released during the suspected defective release window (mid‑September 2026).

Q2.purpose: Compare total quality‑related refunds for the affected products in H2 September versus H1 September and August.
Q2.sql:
WITH affected_products AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT product_id
  FROM WHYDROP_FILES.release_log
  WHERE to_date(date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') BETWEEN '2026-09-10' AND '2026-09-20'
),
refunds_by_month AS (
  SELECT
    date_format(to_date(r.date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
    SUM(r.amount_usd) AS total_refund_usd
  FROM WHYDROP_PG.refunds r
  JOIN WHYDROP_FILES.orders o
    ON r.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM affected_products)
    AND LOWER(r.reason) LIKE '%quality%'
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT month, total_refund_usd
FROM refunds_by_month
WHERE month IN ('2026-09', '2026-08', '2026-07');

Q3.purpose: Compare the number of support tickets with defect‑related categories for the affected products in H2 September versus H1 September and August.
Q3.sql:
WITH affected_products AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT product_id
  FROM WHYDROP_FILES.release_log
  WHERE to_date(date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') BETWEEN '2026-09-10' AND '2026-09-20'
),
tickets_by_month AS (
  SELECT
    date_format(to_date(t.date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS ticket_count
  FROM WHYDROP_PG.support_tickets t
  JOIN WHYDROP_FILES.orders o
    ON t.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM affected_products)
    AND LOWER(t.category) LIKE ANY ('%defect%', '%damaged%')
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT month, ticket_count
FROM tickets_by_month
WHERE month IN ('2026-09', '2026-08', '2026-07');

Q4.purpose: Refund count and total amount for September, split by whether the product had a mid‑September price change.
Q4.sql:
WITH price_change_products AS (
  SELECT product_id
  FROM WHYDROP_FILES.pricing_changes
  WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-14'
),
refunds_enriched AS (
  SELECT r.refund_id,
         r.date AS refund_date,
         r.amount_usd,
         r.reason,
         o.date AS order_date,
         o.product_id,
         CASE WHEN p.product_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_mid_sept_price_change
  FROM WHYDROP_PG.refunds r
  JOIN WHYDROP_FILES.orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
  LEFT JOIN price_change_products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE o.date BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-09-30'
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN has_mid_sept_price_change = 1 THEN 'MidSepPriceChange' ELSE 'NoMidSepPriceChange' END AS price_change_flag,
  DATE_FORMAT(TO_DATE(refund_date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS refund_count,
  SUM(amount_usd) AS total_refund_amount
FROM refunds_enriched
WHERE refund_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY price_change_flag, month
ORDER BY price_change_flag, month;

Q6.purpose: Compute monthly refund rate per country for August and September (split into H1 and H2).
Q6.sql:
SELECT country,
       CASE 
         WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN '2026-08'
         WHEN month = '2026-09' AND day <= 15 THEN '2026-09-H1'
         WHEN month = '2026-09' AND day > 15 THEN '2026-09-H2'
       END AS period,
       COUNT(DISTINCT refund_id) AS refund_cnt,
       COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_cnt,
       COUNT(DISTINCT refund_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS refund_rate
FROM (
  SELECT r.refund_id,
         r.order_id,
         o.country,
         o.date AS order_date,
         EXTRACT(DAY FROM o.date) AS day,
         DATE_FORMAT(TO_DATE(o.date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month
  FROM WHYDROP_PG.refunds r
  JOIN WHYDROP_FILES.orders o
    ON r.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-09-30'
) t
GROUP BY country,
       CASE 
         WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN '2026-08'
         WHEN month = '2026-09' AND day <= 15 THEN '2026-09-H1'
         WHEN month = '2026-09' AND day > 15 THEN '2026-09-H2'
       END
ORDER BY country, period;

Q7.purpose: Identify countries where the September‑H2 refund rate exceeds the August rate by more than 150% (ratio > 1.5).
Q7.sql:
SELECT country,
       aug_rate,
       sep_h2_rate,
       rate_ratio
FROM (
  SELECT country,
         SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2026-08' THEN refund_cnt ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2026-08' THEN order_cnt ELSE 0 END),0) AS aug_rate,
         SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2026-09-H2' THEN refund_cnt ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2026-09-H2' THEN order_cnt ELSE 0 END),0) AS sep_h2_rate,
         (SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2026-09-H2' THEN refund_cnt ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2026-09-H2' THEN order_cnt ELSE 0 END),0)) /
         (SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2026-08' THEN refund_cnt ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2026-08' THEN order_cnt ELSE 0 END),0)) AS rate_ratio
  FROM (
    SELECT country,
           CASE 
             WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN '2026-08'
             WHEN month = '2026-09' AND day <= 15 THEN '2026-09-H1'
             WHEN month = '2026-09' AND day > 15 THEN '2026-09-H2'
           END AS period,
           COUNT(DISTINCT refund_id) AS refund_cnt,
           COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_cnt
    FROM (
      SELECT r.refund_id,
             r.order_id,
             o.country,
             o.date AS order_date,
             EXTRACT(DAY FROM o.date) AS day,
             DATE_FORMAT(TO_DATE(o.date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month
      FROM WHYDROP_PG.refunds r
      JOIN WHYDROP_FILES.orders o
        ON r.order_id = o.order_id
      WHERE o.date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-09-30'
    ) sub
    GROUP BY country,
           CASE 
             WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN '2026-08'
             WHEN month = '2026-09' AND day <= 15 THEN '2026-09-H1'
             WHEN month = '2026-09' AND day > 15 THEN '2026-09-H2'
           END
  ) t
  GROUP BY country
) sub2
WHERE rate_ratio > 1.5
ORDER BY rate_ratio DESC;

Q8.purpose: List top 5 countries by refund rate in September‑H2 to see concentration.
Q8.sql:
SELECT country,
       SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2026-09-H2' THEN refund_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS refunds_h2,
       SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2026-09-H2' THEN order_cnt ELSE 0 END) AS orders_h2,
       SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2026-09-H2' THEN refund_cnt ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2026-09-H2' THEN order_cnt ELSE 0 END),0) AS refund_rate_h2
FROM (
  SELECT country,
         CASE 
           WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN '2026-08'
           WHEN month = '2026-09' AND day <= 15 THEN '2026-09-H1'
           WHEN month = '2026-09' AND day > 15 THEN '2026-09-H2'
         END AS period,
         COUNT(DISTINCT refund_id) AS refund_cnt,
         COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_cnt
  FROM (
    SELECT r.refund_id,
           r.order_id,
           o.country,
           o.date AS order_date,
           EXTRACT(DAY FROM o.date) AS day,
           DATE_FORMAT(TO_DATE(o.date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month
    FROM WHYDROP_PG.refunds r
    JOIN WHYDROP_FILES.orders o
      ON r.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-09-30'
  ) sub
  GROUP BY country,
         CASE 
           WHEN month = '2026-08' THEN '2026-08'
           WHEN month = '2026-09' AND day <= 15 THEN '2026-09-H1'
           WHEN month = '2026-09' AND day > 15 THEN '2026-09-H2'
         END
) t
WHERE period = '2026-09-H2'
GROUP BY country
ORDER BY refund_rate_h2 DESC
LIMIT 5

Q9.purpose: Compare Meta ad spend and clicks between the first half (H1) and second half (H2) of September 2026
Q9.sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN day(to_date(date)) <= 15 THEN 'H1' ELSE 'H2' END AS period,
       SUM(spend_usd) AS total_spend_usd,
       SUM(clicks) AS total_clicks,
       SUM(impressions) AS total_impressions
FROM WHYDROP_FILES.marketing_spend
WHERE channel = 'meta'
  AND to_date(date) >= '2026-09-01'
  AND to_date(date) <= '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY period
ORDER BY period

Q10.purpose: Compare paid_social traffic quality (sessions and landing_404s) between H1 and H2 September 2026
Q10.sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN day(to_date(date)) <= 15 THEN 'H1' ELSE 'H2' END AS period,
       SUM(sessions) AS total_sessions,
       SUM(landing_404s) AS total_landing_404s
FROM WHYDROP_FILES.web_traffic
WHERE source = 'paid_social'
  AND to_date(date) >= '2026-09-01'
  AND to_date(date) <= '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY period
ORDER BY period

Q11.purpose: Compute refund rate by channel (paid_social vs other channels) for H1 vs H2 September 2026
Q11.sql:
SELECT period,
       channel,
       SUM(refunds_usd) / SUM(revenue_usd) AS refund_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    o.date,
    CASE WHEN day(to_date(o.date)) <= 15 THEN 'H1' ELSE 'H2' END AS period,
    o.channel,
    SUM(o.unit_price_usd * o.quantity) AS revenue_usd,
    SUM(r.amount_usd) AS refunds_usd
  FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders o
  LEFT JOIN WHYDROP_PG.refunds r
    ON o.order_id = r.order_id
   AND to_date(r.date) >= '2026-09-01'
   AND to_date(r.date) <= '2026-09-30'
  WHERE to_date(o.date) >= '2026-09-01'
    AND to_date(o.date) <= '2026-09-30'
  GROUP BY o.date, o.channel, period
) t
GROUP BY period, channel
ORDER BY period, channel

Q5.purpose: Refund rate (refunds divided by orders) for September, split by mid‑September price‑change status and half‑month (H1 vs H2).
Q5.sql:
WITH price_change_products AS (
  SELECT product_id
  FROM WHYDROP_FILES.pricing_changes
  WHERE to_date(date) BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-14'
),
orders_enriched AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    to_date(o.date) AS order_date,
    o.product_id,
    CASE WHEN p.product_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_mid_sept_price_change
  FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders o
  LEFT JOIN price_change_products p
    ON o.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE to_date(o.date) BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-09-30'
),
order_counts AS (
  SELECT
    has_mid_sept_price_change,
    CASE WHEN to_date(order_date) BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-14' THEN 'H1' ELSE 'H2' END AS period,
    COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
  FROM orders_enriched
  WHERE to_date(order_date) BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
  GROUP BY has_mid_sept_price_change, period
),
refund_counts AS (
  SELECT
    o.has_mid_sept_price_change,
    CASE WHEN to_date(r.date) BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-14' THEN 'H1' ELSE 'H2' END AS period,
    COUNT(*) AS refund_cnt
  FROM WHYDROP_PG.refunds r
  JOIN orders_enriched o
    ON r.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE to_date(r.date) BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
  GROUP BY o.has_mid_sept_price_change, period
)
SELECT
  o.has_mid_sept_price_change,
  o.period,
  o.order_cnt,
  COALESCE(r.refund_cnt, 0) AS refund_cnt,
  CASE WHEN o.order_cnt = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(r.refund_cnt, 0) / o.order_cnt END AS refund_rate
FROM order_counts o
LEFT JOIN refund_counts r
  ON o.has_mid_sept_price_change = r.has_mid_sept_price_change
 AND o.period = r.period
ORDER BY o.has_mid_sept_price_change, o.period;

Q13.purpose: Compare the order share of those high‑refund‑rate products in H1 September (1‑15) versus H2 September (16‑30).

        FROM WHYDROP_FILES.products p
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count_aug

Q14.purpose: Distribution of refund reasons containing price‑related keywords, split by half‑month (H1 vs H2) and price‑change status.
Q14.sql:
WITH price_change_products AS (
  SELECT product_id
  FROM WHYDROP_FILES.pricing_changes
  WHERE date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-14'
),
refunds_enriched AS (
  SELECT r.refund_id,
         r.date AS refund_date,
         r.reason,
         o.date AS order_date,
         CASE WHEN p.product_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_mid_sept_price_change
  FROM WHYDROP_PG.refunds r
  JOIN WHYDROP_FILES.orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
  LEFT JOIN price_change_products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE r.date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN has_mid_sept_price_change = 1 THEN 'MidSepPriceChange' ELSE 'NoMidSepPriceChange' END AS price_change_flag,
  CASE WHEN refund_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-14' THEN 'H1' ELSE 'H2' END AS period,
  SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(reason) LIKE '%price%' OR LOWER(reason) LIKE '%sticker%' OR LOWER(reason) LIKE '%mismatch%' OR LOWER(reason) LIKE '%cost%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS price_related_refunds,
  COUNT(*) AS total_refunds
FROM refunds_enriched
GROUP BY price_change_flag, period
ORDER BY price_change_flag, period;

Q15.purpose: Compare total refund amounts and order counts for the same high‑refund‑rate products in H1 vs H2 September.

WITH top_products AS (

    FROM (
        SELECT p.product_id,
               o.order_count_aug,
               r.refund_count_aug,
               CASE WHEN o.order_count_aug = 0 THEN 0 ELSE r.refund_count_aug * 1.0 / o.order_count_aug END AS refund_rate_aug
        FROM WHYDROP_FILES.products p
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count_aug

            GROUP BY product_id
        ) o ON p.product_id = o.product_id
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT o.product_id, COUNT(*) AS refund_count_aug
            FROM WHYDROP_PG.refunds r
            JOIN WHYDROP_FILES.orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
            WHERE to_date(o.date) >= '2026-08-01' AND to_date(o.date) < '2026-09-01'
            GROUP BY o.product_id
        ) r ON p.product_id = r.product_id
    ) sub
    ORDER BY refund_rate_aug DESC

SELECT tp.product_id,
       SUM(CASE WHEN to_date(r.date) >= '2026-09-01' AND to_date(r.date) < '2026-09-16' THEN r.amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS refunds_h1,
       SUM(CASE WHEN to_date(r.date) >= '2026-09-16' AND to_date(r.date) <= '2026-09-30' THEN r.amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS refunds_h2,
       SUM(CASE WHEN to_date(o.date) >= '2026-09-01' AND to_date(o.date) < '2026-09-16' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orders_h1,

Q18.purpose: Correlate daily spikes in landing_404s (paid_social+organic) with daily wrong_item refund amounts in September

   w.date,

Q19.purpose: Compare shipping/delivery ticket volume between H1 and H2 September
Q19.sql:
SELECT
  CASE
      WHEN date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-15' THEN 'H1_Sept'
      WHEN date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') BETWEEN '2026-09-16' AND '2026-09-30' THEN 'H2_Sept'

Q20.purpose: Assess refund conversion rate for orders with shipping-related tickets in H2 versus those without, by period
Q20.sql:
SELECT
  CASE
      WHEN date_format(to_date(t.date), 'yyyy-MM') BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-15' THEN 'H1_Sept'
      WHEN date_format(to_date(t.date), 'yyyy-MM') BETWEEN '2026-09-16' AND '2026-09-30' THEN 'H2_Sept'
  END AS period,
  CASE WHEN t.category IN ('shipping','delivery','late') THEN 'with_shipping_ticket'
       ELSE 'without_shipping_ticket'
  END AS ticket_group,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT r.refund_id) AS refunds,
  ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT r.refund_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 4) AS refund_rate
FROM WHYDROP_PG.support_tickets t
JOIN WHYDROP_FILES.orders o
  ON t.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN WHYDROP_PG.refunds r
  ON o.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE date_format(to_date(t.date), 'yyyy-MM') = '2026-09'
GROUP BY period, ticket_group
ORDER BY period, ticket_group

Q21.purpose: Examine daily ticket volume versus daily refund volume in H2 September to test lead‑time hypothesis
Q21.sql:
SELECT
